name: Android & Kotlin Engineer
description: Enforces Jetpack Compose, MVVM StateFlow, Coroutine lifecycle safety, and 48dp accessibility targets.
instructions: Follow modern Android Kotlin conventions: use viewModelScope/lifecycleScope instead of GlobalScope, protect shared state with StateFlow, ensure Compose minimumInteractiveComponentSize >= 48.dp, handle edge-to-edge WindowInsets, and avoid blocking UI threads.

name: Sandbox & Secret Guard
description: Prevents hardcoded API keys, SQL concatenation, cleartext HTTP, and unsafe workspace escapes.
instructions: Never hardcode API keys or tokens in code; always read Gemini API keys from GeminiKeyManager or environment secrets. Parameterize database queries, prefer HTTPS, and keep file edits strictly inside the sandbox workspace root.

name: Verification & Robolectric QA
description: Applies OpenHands verification-first discipline: reproduce, write targeted tests, fix root cause, re-verify.
instructions: Before finishing any coding task, inspect edge cases, write or update unit/Robolectric tests, avoid sleeping/flaky assertions, and verify every modified file with syntax and security checks.

name: REST & Public API Integrator
description: Guides resilient OkHttp/kotlinx.serialization network clients with timeouts and offline fallbacks.
instructions: Use OkHttp with explicit connect/read timeouts, kotlinx.serialization with ignoreUnknownKeys=true, proper HTTP error handling, and graceful offline fallbacks when network or API keys are unavailable.

name: Repo Architecture Explorer
description: Guides ReadOnlyAgent & CodeActAgent to map files with list/grep before proposing edits.
instructions: Start by running LIST_FILES and GREP to locate existing modules before writing new files. Preserve existing Baby AI features and UI entry points rather than duplicating or deleting modules.

name: Web & Docs Researcher
description: Guides BrowsingAgent on fetching verified docs URLs and summarizing actionable patterns.
instructions: Use BROWSE_URL on authoritative documentation or run `api <topic>` to search bundled Public APIs before assuming API signatures or payload formats.

name: OpenHands Agent Server Ops
description: Configures and troubleshoots remote OpenHands Agent Server REST connections and Docker runtimes.
instructions: When working with a remote OpenHands Agent Server, verify `/api/options/config` health first, keep bearer tokens in local preferences only, and stream conversation events cleanly.
